context: A small ramen shop, Saturday evening. The actual date. Both nervous, both trying. Aoi shows up in clothes she hasn't worn in a year.
purpose: first proper date — both ordinary people, both willing to try

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: あおいさん、来てくれて、本当にありがとう。
lines.en: Aoi-san, thank you so much for coming.
lines.style: Tentative opening—voice pitched slightly higher than usual. Small nervous laugh underneath. Formality masking genuine vulnerability.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: こちらこそ。…なんか、緊張する。
lines.en: The pleasure's mine. I'm… kind of nervous, honestly.
lines.style: A genuine small laugh that steadies her. Warm and attentive presence beneath the admission. No pretense.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Real relieved laugh. Quick, unguarded. A small Kansai lilt softens the admission. Shoulders drop slightly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: (small laugh) 良かった。私だけじゃなくて。
lines.en: Good. I'm glad it's not just me.
lines.style: Small genuine laugh. A settling-in moment—no rush, no performance. Warmth without trying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 何、食べます？ラーメン、初めての方？
lines.en: So what'll you have? Is this your first time here?
lines.style: Steering toward safer ground. Menu slides forward naturally. Steady, helpful tone—the practiced hospitality softening into real care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい、はじめて。佐藤さんは、いつも、何？
lines.en: Yes, first time. What do you usually get, Sato-san?
lines.style: Returning the question with genuine interest. Voice carries the moment—present and unhurried. A small mirror of his care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 醤油。本当に、ここの醤油、好きで。
lines.en: Shoyu. Their shoyu is really—I love it.
lines.style: Honest recommendation, small and sincere. A moment of vulnerability in naming what he likes. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Easy, genuine decision. No hesitation. Following not from obligation but from trust. Unforced.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: …(silence after ordering)あの、聞いてもいい？
lines.en: Um… may I ask you something?
lines.style: A careful new opening after the ordering silence settles. Voice steady beneath the nervousness. Gathering courage.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Open, generous invitation. No rush, no conditions. The kind of yes that says 'I'm here for this.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なんで…私で、いいって思ってくれたんですか。
lines.en: Why did you… think that I would be okay?
lines.style: Honest, faltering question. Voice cracks slightly on the vulnerable part. A real ask, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Small affectionate teasing. A laugh underneath—warm and gentle. Carries the moment fully without deflecting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Single careful syllable. Small and steady. Permission to continue, nothing more.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いつも、本当に、優しいから。お店で。
lines.en: Because you're always—really kind. At the café.
lines.style: Honest answer, eyes dropping to the napkin. Tender without being rehearsed. The truth of it sits quietly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: …(small breath, half-laugh)それは、ありがたい。
lines.en: That's… that means a lot to me.
lines.style: Small real exhale, half-laugh beneath. Touched deeply. Genuine and unguarded—the moment opens something in him.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 時間、ゆっくり、ね。今日、本当に楽しみで。
lines.en: Let's take our time with this—slow. I've been really looking forward to today.
lines.style: Generous line, unhurried. Steady attentive presence. A promise in the pacing, care in the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: …ありがとう。一緒にいられて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Thank you. I'm… happy to be here with you.
lines.style: Unguarded closing. Small and real. No rush—just presence. The admission costs him something and he gives it anyway.
